errors.text: The proposed SPS window of 1100-1200°C for 3-4 minutes conflicts with the target regime of 900-1000°C for 10 minutes and exceeds the temperature at which target densification saturates.
The hypothesis internally requires a dwell below 1 minute but then specifies a 3-4 minute dwell.

The claimed HCP threshold above approximately 1250°C and required densification strain rate above 10^-2 s^-1 are unsupported extrapolations from evidence on compositionally different refractory alloys.
